tool.name: run_drastic
tool.description: 使用七个精确 Data version 的 D、R、A、S、T、I、C 栅格和一个独立的 groundwater-drastic-config.v1 配置，按有来源且已核验的 rating rules 与 weights 计算 DRASTIC 相对脆弱性指数、等级栅格和审计摘要。七层必须已严格对齐；本工具不隐式重投影或重采样，结果不是污染概率。

semantics.description: Weighted-sum DRASTIC raster computed cell by cell from independently configured ratings and weights for D, R, A, S, T, I and C; NoData propagates when any factor is missing or has no matching rating.
semantics.grain: one weighted index value per valid aligned raster cell
limitations: All seven rasters must be exactly aligned in CRS, shape, transform and resolution; there is no implicit resampling or reprojection.
A weighted index is conditional on the supplied factor definitions, rating rules, units, bases and weights and is not independently scientifically validated by the platform.
NoData and uncovered ratings remain NoData rather than being imputed or assigned to the nearest rating.
semantics.source: seven exact Data versions plus the exact DRASTIC config version

semantics.description: Integer class codes obtained by applying the config's explicit open/closed index class intervals to valid DRASTIC index cells.
semantics.grain: one class code per index cell covered by a declared class
limitations: The class expresses relative vulnerability under the supplied DRASTIC configuration; it is not a pollution probability.
An index value not covered by a declared class remains NoData and is reported as classification-uncovered.
semantics.source: drastic-index plus the exact config classification source

semantics.description: Audit summary of the exact grid, config and rule version, factor weights, rating and classification source identities, per-factor uncovered cells, NoData propagation, class counts and index statistics.
limitations: Verified source status records the supplied provenance state; it is not independent validation of factor suitability, rating thresholds or factor weight choices.
The summary reports grid and uncovered ratios but does not establish contaminant release likelihood, concentration, travel time, exposure or consequence.
